    Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

    We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

    LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

    You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.


    Tech stack & tools:
    • Linear (backlog, sprints)
    • Confluence
    • Google Workspace 
    • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
    • Figma 
    • QGIS and comparable viewers
    • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
    • very high resolution optical imagery
    • synthetic aperture radar
    • 3D surface models 
    • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
    • agentic tools for a variety of work.


    Your challenge

    As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

    • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

    • Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

    • Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

    About Allica Bank

    Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

    Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

    Department

    People & Talent is a hands-on team helping Allica and its colleagues reach ambitious business goals. We partner across the bank to build the capability, culture and employee experience needed to support growth, while keeping our ways of working simple, practical and focused on outcomes.

    With a new VP of People recently joining Allica, we're putting renewed focus behind our People and Talent agenda. We're looking for a Head of Talent Acquisition who can help shape this next chapter - bringing fresh thinking, strong execution and a clear focus on building a high-performing, proactive TA function.

    Role Description

    The Head of Talent Acquisition will lead Allica’s Talent Acquisition function at an important stage of growth.

    You will own the recruitment strategy and operating model across the UK and India, lead a team of four with three direct reports, and partner closely with senior leaders and hiring managers across the bank. You will also provide ad hoc Talent Acquisition support for our recent expansion into Sweden.

    This is a hands-on leadership role: setting the strategy, improving the operating model, coaching the team, using data to drive decisions and ensuring we hire great people at pace without compromising quality, candidate experience or governance. Reporting directly to the VP of People, you will help shape how Allica attracts and secures the talent needed for the next stage of the bank’s growth.

    Principal Accountabilities

    • Own the end-to-end Talent Acquisition strategy and annual hiring plan across the UK and India, translating business growth plans into clear recruitment priorities, capacity and delivery plans.

    • Lead a team of four, with three direct reports. Set clear standards, coach and develop the team, allocate work effectively and build a high-performing, accountable recruitment function.

    • Oversee end-to-end recruitment across the bank, ensuring strong execution from intake and market mapping through sourcing, assessment, offer and onboarding. Maintain a high bar for quality, pace, diversity and candidate experience.

    • Move TA further towards pipeline-led recruitment, strengthening direct sourcing and talent pooling across technology, banking, risk, commercial and operational hiring. Use agencies selectively and manage external spend with discipline.

    • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and hiring managers, challenging constructively where required and improving capability in role definition, interviewing, calibration and decision-making.

    • Establish clear recruitment MI and regular reporting across measures such as hiring demand, time to hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, funnel conversion, agency usage and recruiter productivity. Use insight to shape decisions and improve outcomes. You will be supported by the Ashby system, LinkedIn recruiter and we are upgrading our HRIS to Sage People by EoY.

    • Own continuous improvement of recruitment processes, ATS/HR technology and supplier governance, ensuring the function operates efficiently and in line with Allica’s control environment.

    • Identify and embed practical AI and automation opportunities that improve sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, recruiter productivity and reporting while maintaining appropriate human judgement and governance.

    • Partner with People, Marketing and business leaders to strengthen employer brand and candidate experience, making Allica easier to discover, understand and choose for critical talent.

    Personal Attributes & Experience

    • Proven experience leading Talent Acquisition in a high-growth technology, fintech or financial services organisation, ideally in an in-house environment.

    • Experience leading a recruitment team through growth and change, with evidence of developing capability, raising standards and improving performance.

    • Strong end-to-end recruitment expertise across multiple disciplines, including technology and other specialist or hard-to-hire roles.

    • Proven direct sourcing and talent-pipeline capability, with a pragmatic approach to agency use and supplier management.

    • Strong data and commercial fluency, able to turn recruitment data into clear insight, decisions and recommendations for senior stakeholders.

    • Experience improving recruitment operating models, processes, governance and ATS/technology enabled ways of working.

    • Confident, credible stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence and constructively challenge senior hiring managers.

    • Experience using AI or automation to improve recruitment activity, with good judgement around appropriate use and governance.

    • Ability to operate across geographies and cultures, with experience of UK and international recruitment environments.

    Working at Allica Bank

    At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

    Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

    • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

    • Options for flexible working

    • Regular social activities

    • Pension contributions

    • Discretionary bonus scheme

    • Private health cover

    • Life assurance

    • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

    Don’t tick every box?

Accountability for each individual supplier relationship sits with the relevant business or service owner.     • Clear and exercised accountability. Define decision rights across supplier owners and the relevant first-line functions, secure approval through the appropriate governance bodies, and ensure responsibilities are understood, exercised and evidenced in practice, intervening directly where they are not.

    Procurement and commercial management

    • Commercial value that is visible and evidenced. Create a consistent approach to demand, sourcing, benchmarking, negotiation, renewal and savings validation so the Bank can demonstrate the value achieved from third-party spend.

    • Stronger outcomes from material negotiations. Lead or support significant contracts and renewals, bringing market insight, leverage and disciplined trade-offs while protecting service quality, resilience, customer outcomes and the control environment.

    • Contracts that work as control instruments.     • Ensure the third-party register is accurate, current and supported by consistent materiality and risk assessments, with regulatory notifications made when required.

    • Intragroup arrangements held to the same standard.     • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

    • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

    • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider Lendable business

      🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

      Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés.

      Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux.

      Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de quatre ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée.

      Ce post-doc est organisé selon quatre axes de travail.

      Le premier axe de travail concernera l’utilisation de l’hydrogène pour favoriser la rupture intergranulaire, préalable indispensable à la spectrométrie Auger sur fracture. Ceci permettra d’accéder à des niveaux de ségrégation faibles, insuffisants pour provoquer une fragilité intergranulaire « intrinsèque ». L’hydrogène est connu pour exacerber, dans certains cas, la fragilité intergranulaire. Il s’agira ici d’explorer les conditions dans lesquelles on peut obtenir pour l’acier de cuve des ruptures intergranulaires assistées par l’hydrogène. On pourra notamment étudier l’effet de la concentration d’hydrogène (introduit par chargement cathodique par exemple) et de la vitesse de sollicitation mécanique. La chaire pourra bénéficier ici des compétences du laboratoire sur la fragilisation par l'hydrogène.

      Le deuxième axe de travail porte sur le développement d'un modèle quantitatif pour l'analyse par Auger de la ségrégation intergranulaire des éléments d'alliages. Il s'agira d'une approche similaire à celle déjà développée pour le phosphore et le soufre, avec la difficulté supplémentaire de soustraire la contribution du volume, ici non-négligeable.

      Les troisième et quatrième axes de ce post-doc s'appuient sur le spectromètre Auger installé en décembre 2025. Cet équipement de dernière génération présente une résolution latérale inférieure à 10 nm. Ceci ouvre de nouvelles perspectives d'analyses que nous souhaitons explorer dans le cadre de la chaire, en particulier concernant l'analyse du carbone et des carbures, qui constitue le troisième axe de travail de ce post-doc. L'analyse Auger de la surface des carbures nanométriques devient possible avec le nouvel instrument et permet d'accéder à la composition chimique des interfaces carbures-matrice. De plus, l'analyse Auger des facettes intergranulaires pourra être faite en-dehors des carbures et permettra d'accéder à la quantification du carbone ségrégé dans le joint.

      Enfin, le dernier axe de travail consistera à développer une méthode de quantification de la ségrégation intergranulaire sans rupture. Il s’agira de travailler ici sur une coupe polie du matériau à étudier et à réaliser des analyses locales, par exemple des profils de concentrations à travers les joints de grains.

      Compte tenu de l'excellente résolution latérale, on peut ainsi espérer détecter la ségrégation par cette méthode. Une méthode de traitement des données devra être développée pour accéder à des concentrations intergranulaires de solutés. Une telle méthode a déjà été mise au point pour des analyses réalisées par nanoSIMS et pourrait être transposée sur la spectrométrie Auger. Elle permettrait de s’affranchir de la nécessité d'obtenir une rupture intergranulaire (particulièrement limitante en spectrométrie Auger), tout en conservant une préparation d’échantillon très simple (coupe polie) et une productivité potentiellement importante (grand nombre de joints analysables dans un échantillon donné).

      About the role

      Imagine owning the quality backbone of an aerospace company moving at full speed. While innovation accelerates around you, you ensure every design and every process meets the highest standards without slowing the momentum. As the Engineering Quality Manager, you will ensure that our engineering Organisation (including the Design Organization (DO)) maintains compliance with applicable standards and best practices (like EASA Part 21 Subpart J, EN9100). You’ll lead the development and oversight of our quality system, manage design supplier qualification and monitoring, drive internal and external audits and continuous improvement across all design, qualification and certification activities.

      At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

      What You´ll Do

      • Be responsible for establishing, documenting, developing and managing the Quality System and for ensuring that it continues to comply with regulatory requirements and business needs.
      • Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes.
      • Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring.
      • Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring
      • Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards).
      • Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes.
      • Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions.
      • Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met.

      Requirements

      What You’ll Need

      • 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry
      • Experience with supplier quality management.
      • Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken.
      • Audit training/certification or experience setting up  ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required.
      • Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs).
      • Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills

      Who You Are

      You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards. When something is not compliant, you speak up. When a process can be better, you improve it.

      Part-Time | Switzerland (Remote) | Global EOR & HR Platform | Employed via Swiss Entity

      ABOUT THE CLIENT

      Our client is a fast-growing global HR, payroll, and compliance platform operating across 180+ regions. The company combines technology with owned entities, in-house legal and payroll expertise, transparent pricing, and dedicated human support - helping businesses of all sizes hire talent anywhere in the world.

      The company is driven by a constant pursuit of innovation, expanding its product suite to create integrated HR solutions for businesses from fledgling startups to global enterprises.

      ABOUT THE ROLE

      We are looking for an HR & EOR Operations Manager to join our Swiss entity on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on operational role - not a purely administrative or advisory position.

      As part of the role, you will serve as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under SECO/Zürich personnel leasing law, fulfilling a standing legal obligation tied to our EOR licence. This means you must be genuinely employed, operationally involved, and present in Switzerland - not an external adviser lending a name to a form.

      Day-to-day workload is manageable within a 50% FTE, and you will be fully supported by the company's global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome, provided they do not interfere with your availability and supervision of the entity's activities.

      This role is a strong fit for HR or EOR professionals already freelancing, holding consulting mandates, or looking to add a substantive part-time role to their portfolio.

      WHAT YOU'LL DO

      • Act as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under Swiss personnel leasing (SECO) law.

      • Ensure compliance with Swiss labour-leasing legislation, Swiss employment law, and the staffing industry GAV (minimum wages and equal treatment).

      • Maintain documentation required for SECO and cantonal audits and inspections.

      • Serve as the primary Swiss contact for SECO and cantonal authorities.

      • Oversee HR and employment operations for the Swiss entity - including onboarding, contract controls, and employment matters.

      • Support payroll oversight in collaboration with the global payroll team.

      • Handle employee and client escalations related to HR and compliance matters.

      • Supervise the entity's EOR/personnel leasing activities and ensure they are conducted properly.

      WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

      Right to Work in Switzerland - one of the following is required:

      • Swiss citizen.

      • EU/EFTA national with a current Swiss B or C permit.

      • Non-EU/EFTA national with a Swiss C permit (a non-EU/EFTA B permit alone does not qualify).

      • EU/EFTA national with a genuine 5-year cross-border G permit.

      Education:

      Any completed qualification - EFZ apprenticeship, Matura/Abitur, or university degree in any field.

      Experience - either route qualifies:

      Standard route:

      3+ years in one of the following: recruitment or placement, personnel leasing or staffing (including EOR), substantive HR (not admin-only), personnel consulting, or organisational/business consulting. Employment certificates confirming dates, workload percentage and substantive duties are required alongside a CV.

      Alternative route:

      3+ years of general professional experience plus a completed, recognised HR qualification with a passed exam (e.g. HRSE or VSH HR Assistant). Course attendance without a final certificate does not count.

      Character:

Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.


The Job

The Configuration Analyst II supports implementation, maintenance, and governance of SCAN Health Plan’s Benefit Configuration, includingPrior Authorization (PA) and Pre-Determination (PD) code sets. This role ensures approved code sets are accurately and timely configured across claims, utilization management, and related operational systems.


The Configuration Analyst II partners with Medical Policy, Utilization Management, Configuration, Information Technology, delegated entities, providers, and vendors to support configuration, reporting, data analysis, system maintenance, and process improvement activities.


You Will

  • Maintains PA and PD code sets across claims, utilization management, and related operational systems.
  • Supports benefit configuration and prior authorization activities, including configuration, testing, validation, deployment, and post implementation review.
  • Serves as a technical liaison for PA and PD configuration activities with internal teams, delegated entities, providers, and vendors.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves benefits and authorization-related configuration issues, technical inquiries, and system problems impacting operational workflows.
  • Supports Annual Enrollment Period (AEP) readiness by completing assigned benefit configuration activities, validating configuration accuracy, and meeting established implementation timelines.
  • Analyzes data to identify trends, risks, process improvement opportunities, and operational or financial impacts.
  • Supports continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing workflows, reporting capabilities, data quality, system functionality, and operational efficiency.
  • Creates and maintains procedures, workflow documentation, training materials, and other resources supporting PA and PD list operations.
  • Maintains knowledge of healthcare coding standards, authorization processes, CMS regulations, healthcare technology, and related best practices.
  • We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
  • Actively support the achievement of SCAN’s Vision and Goals.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 2 or more years of experience in healthcare systems, operations, analytics, medical coding, utilization management, or related technical functions.
  • 2 or more years of experience with reporting, data analysis, SQL, or healthcare-related data.
  • Experience working with healthcare coding systems, code set maintenance, or authorization-related processes.
    Knowledge of healthcare coding systems, including CPT®, HCPCS, and related code sets.
  • Understanding of healthcare claims processing, utilization management, authorization workflows, and healthcare operations.
  • Knowledge of CMS regulations and Medicare Advantage and Medicaid program requirements preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including data interpretation, issue identification, root cause analysis, and solution development.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, performance measurement methodologies, SQL, reporting tools, and business intelligence platforms preferred.
  • QNXT experience is required.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and related business productivity applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Commitment to accuracy, quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and standard office-based work activities, including computer and office equipment use for extended periods.

Experience Preferred:


  • Experience managing Prior Authorization or Pre-Determination Lists.
  • Experience working with Medicare Advantage and/or Medicaid managed care programs.
  • Experience supporting healthcare claims, utilization management, or medical policy operations.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
  • Familiarity with healthcare vendor platforms such as MHK, ikaSystems, CareAxis, or similar applications.
  • Experience utilizing AI-enabled analytical tools and automation technologies.
  • Coursework or training in healthcare analytics, healthcare informatics, business intelligence, or database management.
  • Certification or coursework in SQL and Power BI.
  • Certification in healthcare analytics, data visualization, business intelligence, or related technical discipline.

What's in it for you?


  • Base salary range: $71,700 to $103,732 per year
  • Work Mode: Mostly Remote
  • An annual employee bonus program

Homeless Services, Coordinated Entry System Training and Instructional Design Specialist


ICF’s Homeless Services team works with federal agencies, state and local governments, non-profits, and other community partners to implement evidence-based best practices and to innovate and identify new solutions to ending homelessness. ICF is currently seeking an experienced and mission-oriented candidate to support the development and delivery of high-quality training and capacity building resources for partners and stakeholders in a Coordinated Entry System (CES) for a large Continuum of Care (CoC).

The successful candidate will develop and deliver engaging instructor-led, virtual, online, and blended learning experiences using adult-learning principles and instructional-design best practices. Working closely with CES leadership and subject matter experts, the Specialist ensures that training content reflects current policy priorities, operating procedures, assessment requirements, and system functionality.

The successful candidate will use evidence-based practices and adult learning principles to support users in applying CES requirements, evaluate learner performance, maintain course documentation, and continuously improve training based on participant feedback, assessment results, policy changes, and identified implementation needs.


Please note: This role is contingent upon a contract award. While it is not an immediate opening, we are actively conducting interviews and extending offers in anticipation of the award.

Key Responsibilities:


Course and Content Development

  • Collaborate with subject-matter experts, program leaders, CES users, and participating providers to identify training and performance-support needs.
  • Maintain current knowledge of CES policies, operating procedures, assessment practices, referral workflows, and implementation requirements and stay informed about applicable HUD Coordinated Entry requirements and other guidance affecting CES implementation
  • Analyze gaps in learner knowledge, skills, confidence, and application of CES policies and procedures.
  • Identify target audiences and define the competencies participants should demonstrate after completing training.
  • Establish instructional goals and measurable learning objectives that align with CES policy, operating procedures, system functionality, and intended workplace outcomes.
  • Determine the appropriate instructional approach, delivery format, practice activities, supporting resources, and evaluation methods for each learning need.
  • Apply adult-learning principles, instructional-design models, and current learning-technology practices when developing training, including exercises and activities that strengthen learner engagement, knowledge retention, skill development, and workplace application.
  • Design curricula, course outlines, lesson plans, facilitator guides, participant workbooks, presentations, job aids, frequently asked questions, website tips, and other performance-support resources that strengthen learner retention, capacity, confidence, and job-related competencies.
  • Translate complex policy, procedural, and technical information into clear, accessible, and action-oriented instructional content.
  • Visualize and design instructional graphics, course layouts, user interfaces, storyboards, and finished learning products.
  • Review training content for technical accuracy, policy alignment, instructional quality, accessibility, consistency, and usability.

Training Delivery and Facilitation

  • Prepare and deliver foundational and specialized training on CES policies, processes, workflows, tools, and technologies.
  • Lead engaging in-person training sessions across the Continuum of Care and facilitate live webinars for CES users and participating providers.
  • Use adult learning principles such as demonstrations, exercises, case scenarios, role plays, guided practice, and group discussion to help learners apply CES requirements in realistic settings.
  • Adapt delivery methods to meet the needs of learners with varying roles across CES functions and provider types, experience levels, technical abilities, and familiarity with CES.
  • Clearly explain complex policy, procedural, and technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Model accurate CES practices and reinforce standardized implementation through training, coaching, and technical assistance.
  • Schedule trainings and workshops and communicate with participants regarding registration, prerequisites, course expectations, logistics, learning materials, and follow-up resources.
  • Coordinate training logistics, including room setup, technology, attendance tracking, instructional materials, and webinar administration.
  • Support course setup, enrollment, content maintenance, participant access, completion tracking, and reporting within the learning-management system or other training platform.
  • Travel throughout the CoC geography, as needed, to deliver training and support CES partners.

Quality Improvement and Communication

  • Define criteria for evaluating learner knowledge, skills, competencies, and performance.
  • Develop pre-assessments, knowledge checks, quizzes, skills demonstrations, practice exercises, course assessments, and other evaluation instruments.
  • Align assessments with instructional goals, learning objectives, course content, and expected workplace competencies.
  • Review assessment results, course evaluations, participant feedback, attendance information, and technical-assistance requests to evaluate instructional effectiveness and incorporate improvements based on results.
  • Use root cause analyses or similar techniques to determine whether reported issues relate to training, policy interpretation, user knowledge, system functionality, or broader workflow implementation, and make recommendations to CES Management Entity leadership for further assessment by appropriate CES and CoC leadership
  • Resolve training-related issues directly and refer policy or procedural issues to cross-functional partners within the CES Management Entity for follow-up
  • Identify innovative and cost-effective methods for developing and delivering high-quality trainings at scale

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, adult learning, training and development, human services, public administration, communications, social work, or a related field; an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience may be considered.
  • Minimum two years directly related experience with Continuum of Care program and HUD Coordinated Entry programs.
  • Experience preparing and delivering instructor-led, virtual, or online training for professional audiences.
  • Experience developing curricula, lesson plans, presentations, eLearning content, tutorials, job aids, or other instructional materials.
  • Knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional-design practices, facilitation methods, and learner assessment.
  • Strong public-speaking, presentation, facilitation, writing, interpersonal, organizational, and project-management skills.
  • Ability to explain technical and policy concepts to learners with different roles, experience levels, and technical abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate project, course, and version-control documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.

Job Description

CSCI consulting is seeking a System Architect – MDDI MBSE to support a large-scale Department of War (DoW) digital engineering and SAP S/4HANA transformation program. This role will lead the development of enterprise architecture and system models using Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies to enable mission-critical transportation and logistics capabilities.

You will work within a mature digital engineering environment, partnering with cross-functional teams to design scalable, integrated solutions and drive adoption of the digital thread across the program lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Lead development and maintenance of system, operational, data, and integration architecture using MBSE and DoDAF/UAF frameworks
  • Develop and manage system models (SysML/UML) capturing requirements, interfaces, workflows, and end-to-end mission threads with full traceability
  • Drive digital engineering strategy, including adoption of the digital thread, authoritative models, and model-driven decision making
  • Translate business, operational, and technical requirements into scalable solution architectures supporting enterprise systems and integrations
  • Define integration patterns, interface specifications, and interoperability requirements across DoD and partner systems
  • Establish architecture governance, modeling standards, and technical baselines; support design reviews and leadership briefings
  • Collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, functional, and program teams to resolve risks, gaps, and cross-domain dependencies
  • Contribute to technology roadmaps, transition planning, and implementation strategies for enterprise transformation

Minimum Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship with an active Secret clearance or ability to obtain one
  • 7+ years of experience designing enterprise, system, or solution architectures in DoD or comparable environments
  • Demonstrated systems engineering capability, including decomposition of complex systems and modeling of structure, behavior, interfaces, and data
  • Working knowledge of SysML/UML modeling approaches and experience with recognized MBSE tools (e.g., Cameo, MagicDraw, Sparx EA, Rhapsody, GENESYS)
  • Familiarity with DoDAF, UAF, or similar architecture frameworks
  • Strong communication skills, including experience briefing technical concepts to senior stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Creativity and adaptability in problem-solving
  • Ability to work with clients to understand their needs
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Professional presence

Preferred Skills

  • Active Secret clearance
  • 5+ years of hands-on MBSE / digital engineering experience in complex systems environments
  • Experience supporting DoD logistics, transportation, or ERP modernization programs
  • Experience integrating COTS/ERP platforms with custom DoD systems
  • Familiarity with cloud architectures, DevSecOps, or zero trust environments in DoD (e.g., AWS GovCloud, IL4/IL5)
  • Knowledge of DoD acquisition lifecycle and business process reengineering
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., INCOSE CSEP/ESEP, OCSMP, TOGAF, SAFe, AWS/Azure)
  • Ability to work in a team environment, as well as independently
  • Strong customer and vendor relationship skills
  • Demonstrated ability to comply with data standards and policies
  • Motivation to learn new technologies and methodologies that demonstrate value
  • Past experience working with a Federal local government agency
  • Department of War experience is a plus!

UW Medicine Enterprise Records and Health Information has an outstanding opportunity for an INPATIENT CODER. Experience in a Level 1 Trauma center and/or teaching facility is required.

WORK SCHEDULE

  • 100% FTE, Days

  • Mondays - Fridays

  • 100% Remote

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS

  • Implements the mission and goals of Enterprise Records and Health Information, and incorporating a “patients are first” service culture.

  • Performs daily activities related to of abstract Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) coding and billing

  • Analyzes the medical record to assign International Classification of Diseases (ICD), Clinical Modification (CM) diagnoses and Procedure Coding System (PCS) procedure codes to ensure correct code assignment and optimal reimbursement in compliance with state and federal guidelines

DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION
Enterprise Records and Health Information (ERHI) is a Shared Service Department that supports all aspects of the patient medical record from governance, integrity, documentation timeliness, completion, clinical coding, billing, release, and tracking to management of access, retention, and destruction.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs chart analysis and assigns ICD-CM and ICD-PCS codes using 3M computer assisted coding (CAC) to compute the final DRG assignment to diagnoses and procedures in an integrated system to ensure the appropriate coding for the facility inpatient billing and reimbursement

  • Reviews patient records upon admission and at discharge to the inpatient Rehabilitation Unit; assigns codes to each record to assure proper Case Mix Group (CMG) assignment and appropriate reimbursement to the facility for Medicare Rehab patients

  • Abstracts and/or reviews necessary patient data within EPIC and 3M 360 CAC to ensure data integrity, accurate reimbursement, proper case mix and hospital decision support.

  • Identifies the need for documentation clarity and works with the Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) department to review clinical documentation and/or request provider documentation clarification

  • Maintains four day turnaround times for inpatient coding based on the discharge date and understand charge lag impacts, especially for high dollar accounts and long length of stays (LOS).

REQUIRED POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or equivalent and three years of coding experience or equivalent education/experience.

  • Certified as a Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist – Physician Based (CCS-P), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), Certified Outpatient Coder (COC), Certified Interventional Radiology Cardiovascular Coder (CIRCC), Radiology Certified Coder (RCC) or Radiation Oncology Certified Coder (ROCC).

UW Medicine – Where your Impact Goes Further
UW Medicine is Washington’s only health system that includes a top-rated medical school and an internationally recognized research center. UW Medicine’s mission is to improve the health of the public by advancing medical knowledge, providing outstanding primary and specialty care to the people of the region, and preparing tomorrow’s physicians, scientists and other health professionals.

All across UW Medicine, our employees collaborate to perform the highest quality work with integrity and compassion and to create a respectful, welcoming environment where every patient, family, student and colleague is valued and honored. Nearly 29,000 healthcare professionals, researchers, and educators work in the UW Medicine family of organizations that includes: Harborview Medical Center, UW Medical Center - Montlake, UW Medical Center - Northwest, Valley Medical Center, UW Medicine Primary Care, UW Physicians, UW School of Medicine, and Airlift Northwest.

Forager is a fast-growing data-as-a-service platform providing high-accuracy people and company data to platforms and teams that rely on data to power GTM and recruiting workflows.

We’re building a repeatable, scalable outbound GTM engine targeting data-driven SaaS platforms (sales tech, recruiting tech, AI tools, and data platforms). This is a high-impact role working directly with the founder to design and execute that system from the ground up.

The Role

We’re hiring a GTM Growth Lead (ABM) to build and own our outbound pipeline engine.

This is not a traditional growth marketing role. The focus is:

  • outbound ABM
  • pipeline creation
  • system design
  • experimentation
  • sales enablement

You will define who we target, how we prioritize accounts, how we engage them, and how we build a repeatable, signal-driven GTM engine.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain the TAM
    • Define ICP, segmentation, and targeting
    • Create an evergreen system to identify high-fit accounts
    • Develop account scoring (Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3)
  • Own the outbound motion
    • Design messaging and sequences (email + LinkedIn)
    • Work directly with SDR to improve reply rates and meeting conversion
    • Run weekly experiments (targeting, messaging, offers)
  • Build the GTM system
    • Connect TAM → CRM → outbound workflows
    • Ensure accounts and contacts are enriched and up to date
    • Define tracking for pipeline and engagement
  • Develop signal-driven outreach
    • Identify triggers (hiring, product launches, funding, etc.)
    • Build a system to prioritize accounts based on signals
  • Create playbooks and enable the team
    • Develop repeatable ABM playbooks (1:1 and scaled)
    • Build messaging templates and objection handling
    • Train SDRs and document processes for scale
  • Support deal execution
    • Help create assets (case studies, calculators, data samples)
    • Incorporate sales feedback into messaging and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent Sales-Accepted Tier 1 / Tier 2 meetings held
  • Strong outbound conversion (reply rate → meeting rate)
  • A clear, repeatable outbound playbook

Measurable pipeline contribution from outbound

Important Note: This role is focused on outbound pipeline creation and ABM execution, not paid acquisition or traditional growth marketing.

Requirements

  • Proven experience building outbound / ABM pipeline
  • Track record of generating qualified meetings or pipeline
  • Strong understanding of ICP, targeting, and messaging
  • Hands-on operator (not just strategy)
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup
  • Deep experience with Clay, Sales Nav, or sequencing tools
  • Experience with SaaS platforms (GTM, recruiting, data, AI)
  • Experience training SDRs and building playbooks

Benefits

  • Build the outbound GTM engine from scratch
  • Work directly with the founder
  • High ownership and visible impact on revenue
  • Opportunity to shape how the company scales

Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Role Purpose

    The Professional Services Domain Lead is a senior PS leader with end-to-end accountability for performance, commercial execution, and delivery quality within their domain. The Domain Lead is the authoritative voice on how Keyloop's domain products are scoped, sold, delivered, and continuously improved. They work alongside Regional Delivery Managers to drive consistent execution, and with Product, Engineering, and Sales to ensure the domain portfolio is commercially compelling, operationally fit for purpose, and delivered with repeatability at scale.

    Operating globally and cross-functionally, this role drives the domain's PS execution, ensuring a tight interlock with all functions within the domain to execute on the domain's mission, whilst driving and adopting the core PS standards in delivery excellence. The domains are a critical operating model with the responsibility to deliver the Keyloop Fusion growth plan specific to their domain.

    Underpinning everything is a commitment to customer outcomes — ensuring every engagement drives meaningful software adoption and delivers the business value customers contracted Keyloop to provide

Key Responsibilities

    1. Domain Performance & Commercial Execution

    • Own the commercial performance of the domain across all regions — revenue, margin, utilisation, and time to value.

    • Drive domain pipeline in partnership with Sales and Account Management; contribute to scoping, commercial positioning, and SOW governance to ensure engagements are profitable, deliverable, and set up to achieve customer outcomes from day one.

    • Lead domain performance reviews; hold a clear view of in-flight delivery risk, forecast accuracy, and margin at all times.

    • Identify and pursue growth opportunities within the domain — upsell, expansion, and new use cases — recognising that customers who achieve strong outcomes on the Keyloop Fusion platform are Keyloop's most powerful commercial lever.

    • Ensure PS days within Keyloop Traction programmes and Customer Success Plans are correctly scoped, tracked, and delivered to commercial commitments within the domain.

    2. Fusion & Keyloop Platform: Commercial & Delivery Performance

    • Drive the commercial performance of the domain's Keyloop product portfolio — spanning the relevant Fusion and Keyloop DMS products within scope — ensuring domain delivery contributes to PS revenue, margin, and time to value targets.

    • Own the PS delivery proposition for the Keyloop products within the domain: ensure engagements are correctly scoped, commercially structured, and delivered to a consistent, repeatable standard that drives genuine customer outcomes — not just project closure.

    • Work with Sales and Account Management to position domain-relevant Keyloop product implementations compellingly — translating product capability into clear commercial value and realistic delivery commitments.

    • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure Keyloop Fusion platform products within the domain are implementation-ready: surfacing gaps in delivery readiness, configuration complexity, and integration requirements.

    • Ensure consultants across all regions are equipped to deliver the relevant Keyloop product engagements within the domain confidently — with the methodology, tooling, and domain knowledge to execute at scale.

    3. Delivery Excellence & Methodology

    • Define and own delivery methodology, reference configurations, and reusable solution components for the domain — ensuring consistency, quality, and accelerated time to value across all engagements.

    • Ensure domain delivery is outcome-validated, not just task-completed — every engagement should close with evidence that the customer is using the Fusion platform effectively and has achieved the outcomes they were promised.

    • Partner with Regional Delivery Managers to ensure high-quality, consistent execution of domain projects globally; act as the escalation point for complex, early adopter, and at-risk engagements.

    • Drive down rework and delivery variance by building repeatable, well-documented delivery patterns that consultants can execute without reinventing the wheel.

    • Lead domain input into Keyloop Traction tier design — ensuring Launch, Accelerate, and Supercharge tier definitions reflect realistic, high-quality domain delivery with clear customer outcome criteria at each tier.

    4. Customer Outcomes, Adoption & Success

    • Champion Keyloop's mission to set customers up for success — ensuring every domain engagement is designed, delivered, and measured with that outcome at its centre.

    • Define what good looks like for customer software adoption within the domain: the benchmarks, adoption milestones, and outcome indicators that signal a customer is genuinely succeeding on the Fusion platform.

    • Ensure adoption and outcome validation is built into domain delivery methodology — not left to Customer Success to pick up post go-live.

    • Work closely with Customer Success to track domain customers through the adoption curve; identify patterns where customers are underperforming against expected outcomes and feed those insights back into delivery approach.

    • Ensure smooth, knowledge-rich handovers from PS delivery into Customer Success and Support.

    • Use customer outcome data to continuously improve domain delivery.

    5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Product: Provide structured, evidence-based feedback from PS and customer engagements to influence the domain roadmap.

    • Engineering: Work with R&D and Fusion platform engineering to ensure solution feasibility, delivery scalability, and that products are ready for implementation at pace.

    • Sales: Support commercial conversations, scoping reviews, and customer-facing positioning for domain-specific engagements.

    • Customer Success & Support: Ensure smooth handover from PS delivery into CS and Support; share domain knowledge that helps CS and Support teams accelerate adoption.

    • PS Ops: Collaborate on forecasting, capacity planning, and tooling to ensure domain activity is accurately reflected in operational reporting.

    6. Capability Building & Knowledge

    • Own the domain knowledge base within PS — ensure consultants across all regions have the skills, materials, and structured training needed to deliver domain engagements confidently.

    • Identify capability gaps within the global PS delivery community for the domain; design and implement targeted development to close them.

    • Build and maintain a domain centre of excellence: best practices, lessons learned, delivery patterns, and configuration guides.

    • Drive the onboarding and accreditation of co-delivery partners and GDC teams on domain delivery standards.

    7. Automation, Digitisation & Continuous Improvement

    • Lead the identification and implementation of automation opportunities within domain delivery.

    • Monitor delivery performance data to surface patterns, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities; translate insight into action.

    • Champion a continuous improvement culture within the domain: structured retrospectives, feedback loops from customers and consultants, and rapid iteration on what isn't working.

    • Contribute to Keyloop PS thought leadership — bringing domain expertise to market positioning, customer education, and internal capability.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

    Essential

    • Senior leadership experience in Professional Services within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.

    • Demonstrable commercial acumen: experienced in revenue management, margin accountability, scoping, and contributing to the sales cycle.

    • Deep domain expertise within the relevant Keyloop product area — able to operate as the authoritative voice on implementation approach, configuration, and customer outcomes.

    • Proven ability to drive delivery consistency across geographically distributed teams.

    • Strong cross-functional influencing skills: able to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, and CS without direct authority.

    • Experience operating in or contributing to hub or centre-based delivery models.

    • Data-driven: uses performance insight to manage, improve, and hold teams to account.

    Desirable

    • Knowledge of the automotive dealer or vehicle retail industry.

    • Experience with productised PS frameworks and tiered onboarding models.

    • Familiarity with delivery automation tooling and digitised project delivery workflows.

    • Experience with the Keyloop Fusion platform, Fusion products, or Keyloop DMS solutions.

Qualifications

    Education - Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or equivalent. Relevant postgraduate qualification desirable.
    Certifications - PRINCE2, PMP/PMI or equivalent desirable. SaaS or domain-specific accreditation an advantage.
    Experience - 10+ years in PS, consulting, or technical leadership roles within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.

    What 'Great' Looks Like in This Role

    • Owns the domain like a P&L — clear on the numbers, the risks, and what needs to happen next.

    • The go-to person for Regional Delivery Managers when a domain engagement is complex, at risk, or commercially sensitive.

    • Trusted by Product and Engineering to represent what customers actually need — not just what consultants find hard.

    • Builds a domain delivery community that raises its own bar — through shared knowledge, honest retrospectives, and high standards.

    • Treats customer outcomes as the real definition of delivery success — every engagement is measured by whether the customer is genuinely succeeding on the Fusion platform, not just whether the project closed.

    • Brings commercial and delivery insight to every cross-functional conversation.

  • Ability to make sound decisions and adapt to evolving or partially documented workflows
  • Experience with Asana, Notion, Trello, or similar project management tools is a plus
  • Proficient in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Quiet home office with stable internet (≥10 Mbps download / 2 Mbps upload) and backup connection
  • Bachelor's or Associate's degree preferred

Benefits

Our Core Values at Work

We live by ACTION (get things done), CARE (help others and do things right), OUTSTANDING (operate at the highest standards), DEPENDABLE (own every commitment), and ENERGY (bring positivity every day). You’ll thrive here if these values resonate with you.

What We Offer

  • Hourly rate equivalent to USD $696 – $1,044/month (experience-based).
  • Annual pay increments.
  • Discretionary client bonuses (80 % of clients award year-end bonuses).
  • 7 U.S. federal holidays + 4 paid PTO days.
  • Monthly medical insurance stipend (after meeting eligibility criteria).
  • Birthday / Anniversary bonuses + Gym / Wellness allowance.
  • Unlimited online fitness classes + company events & Christmas celebrations.

IMPORTANT

We would like to inform you that during the first four months of employment, it is critical that candidates are available to work from the countries listed above and without any travel commitments. This is to ensure a smooth onboarding process and to allow new hires to fully focus on their roles and responsibilities.

If you have a trip already planned within the next four months, we kindly request that you apply for our positions after returning from your trip. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to considering your application once you are available to commit to the role.

Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! As a member of First American's family of companies, National Commercial Services provides single-point service for simple to multi-property/multi-state national commercial real estate transactions. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

The Sr. Reverse Exchange Officer is responsible for managing tax-deferral real estate exchanges on behalf of clients, ensuring a seamless process from initiation through closing. They will work closely with clients, advisors and internal teams, including escrow officers and closers, to discuss transaction details, prepare exchange documentation, and guide the exchange process.

What You'll Do

  • This role will be handling reverse exchange transactions

  • Oversee and process mail, deadlines, and updates to files using calendar and tickler systems
  • Review and approve estimated closing statements, manage funds disbursement, and collect applicable fees and interest
  • Supervise and train Exchange Assistants, monitor performance, and assist in interviews and coaching
  • Address escalated customer service issues and foster long-term relationships with clients for business growth
  • Identify opportunities for client acquisition and service expansion, and maintain monthly and annual goals
  • Lead accounting tasks including managing deposits, initiating wires, balancing ledgers, and auditing exchange files
  • Prepare and submit Exchange Closing Statements, final reports, and ensure timely disbursement of funds and 1099s.
  • Review and manage daily, revenue, and SMS reports, and ensure proper organization and filing monthly reports
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • 4+ years related experience
  • Accounting, bookkeeping, customer service or sales experience is preferred
  • Strong customer service orientation
  • Detail orientation
  • Excellent verbal communication
  • Problem solving skills

  • Ability to learn 1031 exchange rules and procedures
  • Computer knowledge/experience
  • Typing skills
  • Basic math skills
  • Organization and planning
  • Flexibility
  • Versatility/ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Leadership abilities
  • Creative problem solving and decision making
  • Customer service skills
  • Coping/stress management skills
  • Detail oriented

Overview

Great Pay! Challenging Work! Continuous Learning! Opportunity to Advance!

Join our team as a D365 Business Central Functional Consultant and help clients improve finance, purchasing, sales, inventory, and operational processes through practical ERP solutions. In this role, you will lead functional discovery, solution design, configuration, testing, training, and go-live support for Business Central implementations and optimization projects. If you enjoy translating business requirements into scalable system solutions and building trusted client relationships, Rand Group offers an opportunity to grow your consulting career while delivering measurable results.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Objective and comprehensive bonus programs reward your contributions:
    • Production Bonus
    • Recruiting Referral Bonus
    • New business referral bonus
  • Major medical health benefits with employer contribution
  • Company paid life insurance, long term disability, short term disability
  • 401k Plan

Work Life Balance:

  • Travel no more than 35%
  • Remote work model
  • PTO accrual increases with tenure

Career Advancement:

  • Performance evaluations
  • 80 hours annual training
  • Personal Development Plan that is updated annually for career progression

Responsibilities

  • Lead and support end-to-end D365 Business Central implementations, assessments, and optimization projects
  • Facilitate discovery sessions to gather, analyze, and document business requirements across finance, purchasing, sales, inventory, and related operational workflows
  • Translate business requirements into functional designs, configuration decisions, and recommend best practices within Business Central
  • Configure core Business Central capabilities, including financial management, sales, purchasing, inventory, approvals, dimensions, and reporting setups
  • Partner with technical consultants and developers on extensions, integrations, data migration, reporting, and issue resolution
  • Plan and execute testing activities, support user acceptance testing, and validate that delivered solutions meet business requirements
  • Deliver end-user training, system walkthroughs, and process documentation to support adoption and long-term success
  • Provide go-live and post-go-live support, troubleshoot functional issues, and recommend continuous improvement opportunities
  • Build strong client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor on ERP process improvement and Business Central capabilities
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, solution development, and mentoring of junior team members as appropriate

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience implementing or supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Dynamics NAV, or a similar mid-market ERP solution
  • Experience as a functional consultant, business analyst, solution consultant, or subject matter expert in ERP implementations
  • Strong understanding of business processes in one or more of the following areas: general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, purchasing, sales, inventory, fixed assets, or basic operations
  • Ability to gather requirements, lead workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, and translate business needs into practical system solutions
  • Experience with configuration, testing, training, cutover, and post-go-live support in ERP projects
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, and client-facing consulting skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively across project teams
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States; willingness to travel to client sites as needed

Why Rand Group?

At Rand Group, you will join a team that combines deep business expertise with a practical, results-driven approach to consulting. Since 2003, we have helped clients modernize operations, improve decision-making, and get more value from their technology investments. Our consultants are trusted advisors who solve complex challenges, build lasting client relationships, and make a measurable impact. We are committed to professional growth through continuous learning, performance-based advancement, and a flexible work environment that supports both collaboration and balance. If you want to do meaningful work alongside smart, driven professionals who care about quality and outcomes, Rand Group offers the platform to grow your career and expand your impact.

      <title>Samsara: Staff Software Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.samsara.com/">https://www.samsara.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.</p>
<p>We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.</p>
<p>We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.</p>
<p><strong>This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p>
<p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world.</strong>&nbsp;The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.</li>
<li><strong>You want to build, not maintain.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.</li>
<li><strong>You want to work where AI meets the physical world.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.</li>
<li><strong>You believe customers are more than a number.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.</li>
<li><strong>You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out.</strong>&nbsp;We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.</li>
<li>Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.</li>
<li>Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.</li>
<li>Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.</li>
<li>Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.</li>
<li>Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.</li>
<li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li>
<li>8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.</li>
<li>Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.</li>
<li>Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.</li>
<li>Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.</li>
<li>Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.</li>
<li>Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.</li>
<li>A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.</li>
<li>Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.</li>
</ul>
<div class="content-pay-transparency">
<div class="pay-input">
<div class="description">
<p>The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.</p>
</div>
<div class="title">Annual Base Salary</div>
<div class="pay-range">$162,400<span class="divider">—</span>$290,000 USD</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="content-conclusion">
<p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p>
<p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why&nbsp;<a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a>&nbsp;are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p>
<p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p>
<p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</p>
<p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p>
<p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p>
</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer</a></p>
</description>
