      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6373/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Beloit, WI 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://acculynx.com">http://acculynx.com</a>
</p>

<h2><strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong></h2>
<p>AccuLynx is a fast-growing SaaS provider of business management software for roofing contractors. With more than 10 years in the business and impressive year-over-year revenue growth, we have quickly established ourselves as the leading software product in this multi-billion dollar industry.</p>
<p>AccuLynx is actively looking for smart and passionate Senior Software Engineers to join our growing Engineering team! We are headquartered out of Beloit, WI and would love to have you join us for major planning sessions and meetings, but this role has the option to be remote. We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to have mastered at least one language and be eager to master any technology or language in the future. If you want to be part of a collaborative team committed to providing a best-in-class software user experience, please read on!</p>
<p>What You Will Do:</p>
<ul>
<li>Support Engineering team in delivering well-written, well-tested code to complete new features or address issues in the product</li>
<li>Collaborate on the design, implementation, testing and review of new features and fixes</li>
<li>Review code and contribute feedback to improve the quality, readability, and testability of the code base across Engineering</li>
<li>Architect, design, develop, deploy and operate services that serve AccuLynx’s thousands of users</li>
<li>Use Agile process to experiment and improve on software development practices at AccuLynx</li>
</ul>
<p>What might you work on?</p>
<ul>
<li>Implement real time communication tools to connect our customers.</li>
<li>Create a fast and responsive work-scheduling application for use in the field.</li>
<li>Build an automation platform so our customers can customize their workflow to reduce wasted movement.</li>
<li>Solve advanced mapping and geolocation problems.</li>
<li>Build out our public RESTful API.</li>
<li>Review junior Engineering team members’ work for accuracy and provide coaching and feedback</li>
<li>Perform other related duties as assigned</li>
</ul>
<p>Your Qualifications:</p>
<ul>
<li>Top notch coding skills</li>
<li>7-10 years of software development experience</li>
<li>7+ years of full-stack web development: frontend, backend and database</li>
<li>Smart and gets things done</li>
<li>Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills</li>
<li>Belief that performance is a feature</li>
<li>Experience with our stack: Vue.js, C#, Sql Server, Redis, ElasticSearch, Git</li>
<li>Confidence you will make a difference in our product</li>
<li>Leverages AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging workflows while maintaining high code quality standards</li>
<li>Actively evaluates and integrates emerging AI coding assistants into the team's development process, sharing best practices to improve overall engineering velocity</li>
</ul>
<p>Bonus Points If You Have:</p>
<ul>
<li>Familiarity with Agile methodologies.</li>
<li>Understanding of HTML5 and mobile responsive development.</li>
<li>Contributions to OSS projects or Stackoverflow.</li>
<li>Availability for after hours support. We work at a sustainable 40h/week pace but sometimes things go bump in the night.</li>
</ul>
<p>Why We Love AccuLynx:</p>
<p>AccuLynx’s success as the #1 business management software for roofing contractors over the past 11 years is thanks to us investing in our employees, maintaining company values and focusing on a strong company culture. Our positive work environment has allowed us to retain employees that have been with us since our company’s inception and has provided the solid groundwork for us to develop an industry-leading product while exceeding our customer’s expectations. Because of our commitment to our company values and culture, we were recently officially recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified™ organization, with 90% of our employees naming AccuLynx as a great place to work.</p>
<p>We’re proud to regularly be recognized for software, product and company culture achievements. Our team’s shared belief in AccuLynx's mission promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation and fun. We have built a benefits program to match the strength of our team. This program includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Attractive compensation packages</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off - 3 weeks off in your first year!</li>
<li>Competitive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)</li>
<li>401K matching and safe harbor contributions</li>
</ul>
<p>Our Interview Process:</p>
<p>We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to be a master of your domain and be eager to learn any technology or language in the future. We aim to reply to your application within a week of receiving it. Our interview process consists of several stages, each one allowing us get to know you better, professionally and technically. It is also an opportunity for you to gain a better understanding of our culture and the work we do at AccuLynx. The stages include:</p>
<ul>
<li>CV, open source code, or public portfolio review</li>
<li>Phone interview with HR team</li>
<li>Face to Face conversation with a few members of your team.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Applicants must be able to work legally within the United States. Please, no 3rd party inquiries.</em></p>
<p><em>AccuLynx is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion and employing a diverse workforce. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/acculynx-senior-software-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/acculynx-senior-software-engineer</a></p>
</description>

<p>Summary<br>We are seeking a Data Engineer to support the development of a Data Intelligence Platform. and reporting needs.<br>- Support implementation, technical issues, and training related to the data lake ecosystem.<br>- Work with the team to manage AWS resources, including EMR and ECS reduction.</p><p><strong>Required experience</strong><br>- 7-9 years of experience designing and developing cloud-based data models, ETL pipelines, and infrastructure.<br>- Experience working with both structured and unstructured data.<br>- Strong proficiency with SQL across popular databases.<br>- Experience optimizing large, complex SQL statements.<br>- Knowledge of best practices for relational databases.<br>- Experience configuring database engines and orchestrating clusters.<br>- Ability to plan resource requirements from high-level specifications.<br>- Ability to troubleshoot common database issues.<br>- Experience with Spark, Glue, EMR, and Apache Kafka or AWS Kinesis.<br>- Experience with version control tools such as Git or Subversion.<br>- Experience using automated build systems and CI/CD workflows.<br>- Experience programming in Java, Python, and Scala.<br>- Knowledge of data structures and algorithms.<br>- Knowledge of relational, NoSQL, graph, document, key-value, and time-series databases.<br>- Knowledge of scalable data model design and management.<br>- Knowledge of ML model deployment.<br>- Knowledge of AWS cloud platforms.<br>- Knowledge of TDD and BDD.<br>- Strong interest in improving software development skills, frameworks, and technologies.</p><p><strong>Engagement highlights</strong><br>- Opportunity to work across data modeling, data services, and data science within a broader Data Intelligence Platform.<br>- Exposure to a varied technical environment spanning AWS, ETL pipelines, databases, search technologies, and recommendation systems.<br>- Direct collaboration with data science teams and internal stakeholders on reporting, transformation, and platform capabilities.</p>

      <title>Reddit: Backend Engineer, IAM</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text">
<div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first">
<div class="p-rich_text_block">
<div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div></div><p><strong>This is a remote-friendly role. Reddit has a flexible first workforce.</strong></p>
<p>The Identity and Access Management team develops and maintains a set of mission critical, highly performant, and highly scalable systems that manage user identity, authentication, and authorization for all of our millions of daily users and backend services.</p>
<p><strong>Some of our present and future challenges include:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Building systems around consumer IAM to meet the needs of Reddit’s engineering organization and millions of daily users.</li>
<li>Design, build and ship backend services powering experiences for one of the most visited sites in the world.</li>
<li>Work with product management, security, client engineering, and backend teams to define and implement Reddit’s IAM vision and roadmap.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>In your day-to-day, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Steer: Work with the team to select, scope, and execute on high leverage projects that align with Reddit’s goals.</li>
<li>Build: Execute on a strategy and create a more performant, more scalable, higher quality architecture around IAM.</li>
<li>XFN Collaboration: Work together with a variety of cross functional teams across Reddit Engineering.</li>
<li>Evolve: Learn and improve your own technical and non-technical abilities.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Who you might be:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience designing and developing distributed backend systems&nbsp;</li>
<li>IAM backend experience in either authorization or authentication domain</li>
<li>Proficiency in one or more general purpose programming languages (preferably Go).</li>
<li>Capability with essential cloud infrastructure (Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS, GCP).</li>
<li>High empathy and excellent communication skills to collaborate across the organization.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs</li>
<li>401k with Employer Match</li>
<li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li>
<li>Family Planning Support</li>
<li>Gender-Affirming Care</li>
<li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li>
<li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Generous Paid Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Pay Transparency:</strong></p>
<p>This job posting may span more than one career level.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. <p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pinterest:</strong></p>
<p>Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.</p>
<p>Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/">flexibility</a> to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p>
<p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.</p>
<p>Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/">here</a>.</p></div><p>Pinterest brings millions of people the inspiration to create a life they love. Behind that experience is a complex infrastructure ecosystem that powers reliability, performance, measurement, and efficiency across the platform. As Pinterest grows, it’s increasingly important that we understand these systems clearly so we can make smarter decisions for both Pinners and the business.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Infrastructure Data Science team. In this role, you’ll partner with engineering and cross-functional teams to make Pinterest’s infrastructure more measurable, intelligible, and actionable. Depending on the area, your work may span app performance, shopping infrastructure, metrics quality, infrastructure governance, or site reliability. You’ll help build the data foundations, measurement systems, and analytical frameworks that enable Pinterest to optimize core technical systems and make better product and infrastructure decisions.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>
<p>In this role, you will partner closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to improve how Pinterest measures, understands, and optimizes its infrastructure:</p>
<ul>
<li>Partner with engineering teams to define, measure, and improve the health, quality, and efficiency of Pinterest’s infrastructure systems.</li>
<li>Build and refine metrics, dashboards, and analytical frameworks that make complex technical systems more understandable and actionable.</li>
<li>Strengthen data foundations by improving metric definitions, auditing data quality, and contributing to pipeline and measurement improvements where needed.</li>
<li>Design and analyze experiments, investigations, and deep dives to quantify the impact of infrastructure changes on user experience, reliability, and business outcomes.</li>
<li>Translate ambiguous technical problems into clear analyses and actionable recommendations for engineering and platform partners.</li>
<li>Support high-priority investigations and decision-making related to infrastructure performance, reliability, cost, and measurement quality.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to improve how Pinterest measures and optimizes infrastructure across a range of domains, such as performance, shopping infrastructure, governance, metrics quality, and site reliability.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Masters degree in a relevant field such as Statistics, Applied Math, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience.</li>
<li>Strong SQL and analytical programming skills, with experience working through messy, imperfect data and building reliable metrics and datasets.</li>
<li>Experience partnering on or contributing to production-ready data pipelines, measurement systems, or foundational data work that improves data quality and usability.</li>
<li>Solid foundation in experimentation and measurement, with the ability to design analyses, interpret results rigorously, and partner effectively with engineers and other cross-functional stakeholders.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear analytical workstreams and actionable recommendations.</li>
<li>Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to engineering, product, and platform stakeholders.</li>
<li>Ability to operate independently, prioritize across both longer-term projects and fast-turn inbound requests, and drive work forward in a dynamic environment.</li>
<li>Curiosity and a builder mindset, with excitement for improving messy systems and creating more scalable, trustworthy measurement foundations.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.</span></p>
</li>

<ul>
<li>This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/pinflex/"> PinFlex</a> page to learn more about our working model.</li>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> NYC, Remote; San Francisco, California
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p>
<p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p>
<p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p>
<p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2>
<p>Fin is looking for an exceptional Solutions Architect to join our vibrant Customer Solutions Team. In this role, you’ll engage directly with our customers as their trusted advisor, playing a pivotal part in defining and demonstrating value across the entire sales cycle. With a natural curiosity, independent thinking, and strong problem-solving skills, you’ll partner closely with Product, R&amp;D, and Engineering to ensure our customers’ needs and insights are at the core of our AI powered solutions.</p>
<h2>What will I be doing?&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Lead technical discovery to identify and address our customers’ needs</li>
<li>Deliver an exceptional pre-sales experience by articulating Fin's value and technical expertise</li>
<li>Conduct impactful, value-based solution reviews and in-depth technical sessions</li>
<li>Design and lead tailored Proof of Concepts (POCs) that showcase Fin's capabilities</li>
<li>Serve as the primary resource for RFPs and customer security questions, utilizing standardized materials and escalating complex issues</li>
<li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to represent the customer voice, gathering feedback and insights for product planning</li>
<li>Build trust with customers by approaching challenges with empathy and curiosity</li>
<li>Continuously improve processes and contribute to building a best-in-class Solutions Engineering playbook at Fin</li>
<li>Commit to customer success, ensuring lasting value and proactively addressing challenges</li>
</ul>
<h2>What skills do I need?&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Minimum of 3 years of experience in a technical sales role, managing C-Level technical and business relationships</li>
<li>Strong technical acumen with experience in conducting technical discovery and delivering high-impact value presentations.</li>
<li>Ability to solve problems independently while thriving in collaborative team environments</li>
<li>Proven time management skills in a dynamic team environment&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to quickly identify and communicate the value proposition throughout the sales cycle.</li>
<li>Leverage your skills in translating complex business challenges into tailored Fin solutions, effectively communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive understanding and impact.</li>
<li>Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to communicate customer feedback and influence product direction.</li>
<li>Familiarity with managing POCs, RFPs, and addressing complex security questions.</li>
<li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a passion for leading with empathy and curiosity</li>
<li>Ability to challenge the status quo and continuously improve Solutions Engineering processes and playbooks</li>
<li>Bring an open mind, be a collaborative colleague with a commitment to go above and beyond to drive the success of your team and the company</li>
<li>Willing and able to travel occasionally</li>
</ul>
<p>*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.</p>
<p>The OTE salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City is $190,800-$227,900 Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>#LI-Hybrid</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p>
<p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p>
<p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p>
<p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.&nbsp;<a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><strong>Job Title: Commercial Account Manager</strong></p>
<p><strong>Location: United States - Remote</strong></p>
<p>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY:</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Commercial Account Managers are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Full-Cycle Account Ownership:</strong> Serving as the primary point of contact and ultimate owner of the account relationship, managing all commercial transactions including upsells, cross-sells, and the end-to-end renewal process.</li>
<li><strong>Driving Net-New Revenue:</strong> Actively prospecting within your assigned territory to identify, qualify, and close new ACV opportunities within your install base to expand your total book of business. Actively hunt for opportunities to introduce additional products or seat expansions to existing customers, maximizing the lifetime value (LTV) of your portfolio.</li>
<li><strong>Account Planning:</strong> Developing and executing success plans for high-value accounts to ensure long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.</li>
<li><strong>Proactive Retention Management:</strong> Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.</li>
<li><strong>Executive Relationship Building:</strong> Cultivating ties with VPs, C-suite executives and key stakeholders to move beyond a vendor relationship and become a trusted business advisor.</li>
<li><strong>Forecasting &amp; Pipeline Accuracy:</strong> Provide leadership with accurate monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts for both net new bookings and churn.</li>
<li><strong>Market &amp; Competitive Intelligence:</strong> Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to resolve complex client issues and ensure seamless post-sale transitions.</li>
<li><strong>Segmented Renewal Strategy:</strong> Partnering with Renewal Account Managers to streamline the execution of long-tail, lower-spend accounts, while simultaneously identifying and "cherry-picking" growth potential within that book to migrate into higher-value tiers.</li>
</ul>
<p>In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Commercial Account Manager. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.</p>

<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>

      <title>Legion: Chief Architect</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, United States
</p>

<h1><strong>Chief Architect</strong></h1>
<h1><span><strong>Remote - US</strong></span></h1>
<p>Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation.</p>
<p>This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems.</p>
<p><strong>This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity.</strong></p>
<p>The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it.</p>
<p>This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO.</p>
<h2><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making</strong></h3>
<p><strong>Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution.</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction.</li>
<li>Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization.</li>
<li>Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction.</li>
<li>Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability.</li>
<li>Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk.</li>
<li>Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Platform Architecture and Technical Vision</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Define and own the long-term architecture for Legion’s AI-driven Workforce Management platform across application services, data infrastructure, ML systems, optimization engines, APIs, integration architecture, developer platforms, and enterprise-scale operations.</li>
<li>Establish engineering-wide standards for system design, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, observability, security, and maintainability.</li>
<li>Serve as the final architectural authority for major platform initiatives and technical decisions with long-term consequences.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, improve system efficiency, accelerate engineering velocity, and unlock new product capabilities.</li>
<li>Proactively surface technical debt, architectural risk, and platform constraints before they compound into customer, product, or engineering velocity issues.</li>
<li>Create pragmatic migration paths from current-state architecture to target-state architecture while maintaining uptime, customer trust, backward compatibility, and delivery speed.</li>
<li>Ensure Legion’s architecture supports enterprise configurability and extensibility without allowing uncontrolled customization or product fragmentation.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>AI, Optimization, and Decision Systems</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Architect AI-native product capabilities across forecasting, scheduling, labor optimization, recommendations, copilots or agents, anomaly detection, decision automation, and other intelligent workforce management use cases.</li>
<li>Define the architecture for production AI systems, including data pipelines, feature platforms, model training, model serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, feedback loops, and continuous improvement.</li>
<li>Make clear build-versus-buy decisions across LLMs, classical ML, optimization solvers, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and internal AI platforms.</li>
<li>Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to turn mathematically complex labor optimization problems into reliable, scalable, explainable production systems.</li>
<li>Establish standards for AI system quality, including accuracy, latency, cost, explainability, drift detection, reliability, customer-specific behavior, and production observability.</li>
<li>Ensure Legion’s AI capabilities remain differentiated, defensible, enterprise-ready, and deeply integrated into operational workflows rather than bolted on as superficial features.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Distributed Systems, Data, and Enterprise Scale</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Drive architecture for large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS systems serving complex enterprise customers with high availability, performance, security, and compliance expectations.</li>
<li>Lead technical decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed data processing, real-time systems, data governance, and large-scale analytics.</li>
<li>Improve the architecture for observability, incident analysis, performance engineering, capacity planning, reliability, and operational excellence.</li>
<li>Use production data, incidents, escalations, and customer operational patterns as inputs into architecture and platform improvement.</li>
<li>Ensure architectural decisions support global scale, data residency, enterprise integrations, configurability, extensibility, and long-term platform leverage.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Product, Business, and Customer Impact</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Connect technical decisions directly to customer value, product velocity, implementation speed, scalability, reliability, and long-term platform advantage.</li>
<li>Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate ambitious product goals into executable architecture and technical roadmaps.</li>
<li>Understand enterprise customer complexity and design systems that support real-world operational variability without creating unsustainable technical debt.</li>
<li>Support strategic customer, partner, and vendor architecture discussions where deep technical credibility is required.</li>
<li>Help evaluate technical implications of major product, partner, platform, and commercial decisions.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Engineering Culture and Technical Talent</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Mentor and elevate Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, architects, and senior engineering leaders across the organization.</li>
<li>Raise the bar for technical judgment, system design, architecture reviews, documentation, code quality, operational discipline, and engineering craftsmanship.</li>
<li>Help assess, attract, and develop senior technical talent, including Staff, Principal, and architect-level engineers.</li>
<li>Build a culture of disciplined technical thinking, direct debate, clear decision-making, and pragmatic execution.</li>
<li>Ensure architectural decisions are documented clearly, understood broadly, and translated into executable engineering plans.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Security, Compliance, and Enterprise Readiness</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own the architectural approach to enterprise security, data governance, privacy, compliance, auditability, and resilience.</li>
<li>Ensure architecture supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, data residency, access control, tenant isolation, regulatory requirements, and other needs of large global enterprise customers.</li>
<li>Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to make security and compliance foundational architectural properties rather than after-the-fact controls.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Travel Requirements</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Up to 15% travel for leadership collaboration, engineering offsites, strategic customer engagements, and other business-critical meetings.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Required Skills and Qualifications</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>Experience Level</strong></h3>
<p><strong>15+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software systems.</strong><strong>Prior experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Principal Architect, very senior Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Demonstrated success designing and scaling mission-critical, multi-tenant SaaS platforms for enterprise customers.</li>
<li>Deep hands-on experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data platforms, APIs, event-driven systems, platform engineering, and high-availability production environments.</li>
<li>Proven ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can credibly engage in code-level and design-level discussions with senior engineers.</li>
<li>Experience making major architecture decisions for systems with high scale, high reliability requirements, complex domain logic, and long product lifecycles.</li>
<li>Experience modernizing large production systems incrementally while maintaining uptime, backward compatibility, customer trust, and engineering velocity.</li>
<li>Experience building or supporting AI, ML, optimization, decisioning, forecasting, or data-intensive products in production.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of observability, incident response, performance engineering, reliability architecture, capacity planning, and operational excellence.</li>
<li>Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Technical Depth</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep expertise in distributed systems, system design, cloud architecture, service-oriented or microservices architectures, APIs, event-driven systems, and large-scale data processing.</li>
<li>Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.</li>
<li>Strong experience with modern engineering practices, including architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, testing strategy, deployment architecture, observability, and production operations.</li>
<li>Experience with languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Scala, or similar modern backend languages.</li>
<li>Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs involving performance, latency, throughput, cost, reliability, developer productivity, extensibility, and maintainability.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Leadership and Judgment</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Strong architectural judgment: knows when to simplify, when to re-platform, when to tolerate debt, and when to force a hard technical reset.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to make bold technical decisions with incomplete information and drive alignment across senior technical and executive stakeholders.</li>
<li>Ability to influence without relying on hierarchy, while still being willing to make clear decisions when consensus is insufficient.</li>
<li>Strong product and business judgment; able to connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes, implementation speed, product differentiation, and company strategy.</li>
<li>Pragmatic builder mindset: balances long-term architecture with startup speed, customer urgency, and execution realities.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications and Attributes</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience building platforms used by millions of users or supporting very large-scale enterprise operations.</li>
<li>Experience at companies known for large-scale distributed systems, AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, workforce management, supply chain, fintech, commerce, logistics, or other complex operational domains.</li>
<li>Familiarity with optimization engines, scheduling algorithms, forecasting systems, constraint solvers, real-time decision systems, or mathematically complex production systems.</li>
<li>Experience architecting AI-native product capabilities, including LLM-enabled workflows, AI agents or copilots, model evaluation, retrieval systems, feedback loops, and production monitoring.</li>
<li>Experience building internal developer platforms, platform infrastructure, data platforms, ML pipelines, or large-scale analytics systems.</li>
<li>Experience designing highly configurable enterprise platforms without creating unbounded customization or implementation complexity.</li>
<li>Experience participating in strategic customer architecture reviews or technical due diligence with large enterprise customers.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; PhD a plus but not required.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></h2>
<p>The strongest candidate will be a deeply technical, hands-on architect who still has the range to shape company-level technical direction. They are not a generic enterprise architect, process owner, or strategy-only leader. They are a builder and technical decision-maker who can personally engage with Legion’s hardest problems and earn the respect of the strongest engineers in the company.</p>
<p>They should be comfortable moving between:</p>
<ul>
<li>Code and architecture.</li>
<li>Product ambition and technical feasibility.</li>
<li>AI innovation and production reliability.</li>
<li>Startup speed and enterprise-grade rigor.</li>
<li>Long-term platform strategy and immediate technical execution.</li>
</ul>
<p>They should be opinionated but not dogmatic, decisive but not reckless, and pragmatic without accepting mediocrity. They should be able to simplify complex systems, identify the real technical risks, and force clarity where teams are stuck in ambiguity.</p>
<h2><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h2>
<p><strong>Salary Range: Base Salary Range $300,000- $385,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity.</strong></p>
<p>At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.</p>
<p>Our posted salary range is done in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region, town, or cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount budgeted internally, and internal equity for the same position within the company.</p>
<p>Benefits include, but are not limited to:</p>
<ul>
<li>$0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment.</li>
<li>401k plan.</li>
<li>Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays.</li>
<li>Parental Leave.</li>
<li>Equity.</li>
<li>Monthly Wellness Reimbursement.</li>
<li>Monthly Lunch on Legion.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>ABOUT LEGION</strong></h3>
<p>Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.</p>
<p>Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.&nbsp;</p>
<p>If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.</p>
<h3><strong>BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p>There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.&nbsp; Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.</p>
<p>For more information, visit<a href="https://legion.co"> https://legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY</strong></h3>
<p>Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.</p>
<h3><strong>DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION</strong></h3>
<p>For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co&nbsp;</p>
<p>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @<a href="http://legion.co">legion.co</a> domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span><em>Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</em></span></p>
<h2>How We Determine What We Pay</h2>
<p><em>As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.</em></p>

(“<strong>Legion</strong>”, “<strong>we</strong>”, “<strong>us</strong>” and “<strong>our</strong>”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.</p>
<p>This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co/privacy-policy/">Legion Privacy Policy</a>&nbsp;applies.</p>

      <title>Track it Forward: Lead Developer — Rebuild, Modernize, & Scale (Social Good SaaS, Remote)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0015/7892/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Oakland, CA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.trackitforward.com">https://www.trackitforward.com</a>
</p>

<p>We are looking for a lead developer to do a greenfield rebuild of our legacy SaaS app, modernize our mobile apps, and lead the tech effort to scale our app.&nbsp; You will help choose the language, build the technical foundation, work with our product manager to rebuild the app, and migrate all customers over.</p>
<p><strong>About Track it Forward </strong>Track it Forward is the leading volunteer time-tracking application for nonprofits and schools. For 15 years, we’ve helped thousands of organizations mobilize volunteers and track over 30 million hours. We are a profitable, bootstrapped team of 4 focused on great work-life balance, high-impact work, and a fun, puzzle-loving culture (daily crosswords, monthly virtual escape rooms, and annual retreats).&nbsp; We are not a VC-funded startup. We grew organically, stayed profitable, and prioritize high-quality work and personal fulfillment without growth-at-all-costs pressure. The team is led by the original founder and developer.</p>
<p><strong>The Modernization Strategy</strong> This is a structured, phased "small bang" migration—not a high-risk cutover or a strangler-fig migration. You will build a parallel greenfield system, extract legacy components step-by-step, and migrate customers over incrementally tenant-by-tenant while keeping operations running smoothly.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Current Tech</strong>: Drupal 6 architecture hosted on Pantheon, paired with two Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Your Scope: </strong>Complete ownership of the technical architecture. You will partner with our product manager, establish engineering processes, and lead the rebuild from scratch.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Modern AI practices</strong>:&nbsp; We want you to be on the cusp of AI workflows while also balancing human guardrails to produce quality code.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Team Structure:</strong> You will be our sole developer in the short term, taking full technical helm as we scale.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Target Stack &amp; Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Core Tech Stack:</strong> Core backend/frontend rebuild focused on Python/Django, Laravel, or React. You will make the final architectural call with input from the CEO/founder.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Database &amp; Storage Extraction: </strong>Deconstruct our legacy Drupal 6 / MySQL schema into a clean, domain-driven PostgreSQL database, and offload 100GB+ of media files to AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Security &amp; Isolation</strong>: Implement application-layer field-level encryption (AES-256 for PII, Bcrypt/Argon2id for passwords) and build zero-trust dev environments so contractors never handle production user data.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>CI/CD &amp; Documentation:</strong> Establish automated testing pipelines, clean API contracts, and clear runbooks so the codebase remains maintainable long-term.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Mobile App Maintenance:</strong> Maintain and update our two Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps using AI coding tools. Mobile is a small fraction of the overall role—you just need to leverage AI to keep them functional without being a native mobile expert.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Candidate Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Pre-AI Engineering Foundation:</strong> 5+ years of core software engineering and architectural experience established before generative AI existed. You hold strong first-principles opinions on database normalization and system patterns.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Proven Migration Experience:</strong> You have successfully architected and led at least one legacy monolith migration. You know what inputs and scope decisions keep momentum going.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Modernized AI Velocity:</strong> You actively use AI tools to multiply output, but retain strict architectural control, unit testing discipline, and manual code review standards.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location &amp; Remote Flexibility</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>US W-2 Tax Residency Required: </strong>You must be legally authorized to work in the US and maintain primary US tax residency (for payroll, contracts, and legal/tax compliance).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Travel-Friendly:</strong> We are 100% remote. As long as your primary legal/tax home remains in the US, you are welcome to travel or digital nomad—provided you can consistently hit our core sync hours.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Core Sync Hours: </strong>Mandatory availability from 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM PST for daily team syncs and real-time collaboration. Flexible hours outside this window.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Base Salary: </strong>$150,000 – $200,000 / year (commensurate with experience)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Benefits:</strong> 401(k) w/ company match, Health Insurance, vacation, PTO, and holdiays</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Culture:</strong> High autonomy, direct project ownership, and zero venture-capital growth pressure</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>How to Apply</strong> To filter out automated spam: include the most authentically human, non-AI reason why this specific role resonates with you.&nbsp; Specifically include a short Loom video of you in the “Why should we choose you over any one else?” question.&nbsp; This isn’t required but will sure stand out.&nbsp; Be authentic, no need to do crazy rehearsals, just be you.</p>
<p><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYTV6wp3DOlqoECwDqq4_tfYvQ2fMHvDrnDUmTjwpu_cf7jA/viewform?usp=preview">Apply at this google form here</a></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> NYC, Remote; San Francisco, California
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a> is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p>
<p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.</p>
<p>Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2>
<p>Fin is looking for an exceptional Portuguese and Spanish Speaking Senior Solutions Engineer to join our vibrant Customer Solutions Team. In this role, you’ll engage directly with our customers as their trusted advisor, playing a pivotal part in defining and demonstrating value across the entire sales cycle. With a natural curiosity, independent thinking, and strong problem-solving skills, you’ll partner closely with Product, R&amp;D, and Engineering to ensure our customers’ needs and insights are at the core of our AI powered solutions.</p>
<h2>What will I be doing?&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Lead technical discovery to identify and address our customers’ needs</li>
<li>Deliver an exceptional pre-sales experience by articulating Fin's value and technical expertise</li>
<li>Conduct impactful, value-based solution reviews and in-depth technical sessions</li>
<li>Design and lead tailored Proof of Concepts (POCs) that showcase Fin's capabilities</li>
<li>Serve as the primary resource for RFPs and customer security questions, utilizing standardized materials and escalating complex issues</li>
<li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to represent the customer voice, gathering feedback and insights for product planning</li>
<li>Build trust with customers by approaching challenges with empathy and curiosity</li>
<li>Continuously improve processes and contribute to building a best-in-class Solutions Engineering playbook at Fin</li>
<li>Commit to customer success, ensuring lasting value and proactively addressing challenges</li>
</ul>
<h2>What skills do I need?&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Portuguese and Spanish Fluency are required</li>
<li>Minimum of 4 years of experience in a technical sales role, managing C-Level technical and business relationships</li>
<li>Strong technical acumen with experience in conducting technical discovery and delivering high-impact value presentations.</li>
<li>Ability to solve problems independently while thriving in collaborative team environments</li>
<li>Proven time management skills in a dynamic team environment&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to quickly identify and communicate the value proposition throughout the sales cycle.</li>
<li>Leverage your skills in translating complex business challenges into tailored Fin solutions, effectively communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive understanding and impact.</li>
<li>Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to communicate customer feedback and influence product direction.</li>
<li>Familiarity with managing POCs, RFPs, and addressing complex security questions.</li>
<li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a passion for leading with empathy and curiosity</li>
<li>Ability to challenge the status quo and continuously improve Solutions Engineering processes and playbooks</li>
<li>Bring an open mind, be a collaborative colleague with a commitment to go above and beyond to drive the success of your team and the company</li>
<li>Willing and able to travel occasionally</li>
</ul>
<p>*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.</p>
<p>The OTE salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City is $231,100-$276,275 Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>#LI-Hybrid</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements.<br><br>Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at <span><a href="http://fin.ai/careers">fin.ai/careers</a></span>.</p>
<p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p>
<p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Fin values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. Fin will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fin-senior-solutions-engineer-latam">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fin-senior-solutions-engineer-latam</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Prove: Director, Channel & Partnerships</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; United States (Remote)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h1><img src="https://i.imgur.com/gwyI98w.png" alt="We're Hiring!" width="100%"></h1>
<h1>About Prove&nbsp;</h1>
<div>
<p><span>As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/proveidentity/"><span>follow us on LinkedIn.</span></a></p>
<p><span>Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team!&nbsp;</span></p>
</div></div><p><strong>Title:</strong> Director, Channel &amp; Partnerships</p>
<p><strong>Department:</strong> Partnerships</p>
<p><strong>Reports To:</strong> VP, Channels &amp; Partnerships</p>
<p><strong>FLSA Status:</strong> Exempt</p>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> New York, NY or remote</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>The partner ecosystem is a significant and fast-growing part of Prove’s success and growth strategy. We are looking for an exceptional, revenue-driven partner operator to join as a <strong>Director of Channel &amp; Partnerships</strong>. This role is 100% focused on sourcing, structuring, and launching high-impact Reseller and OEM partnerships within the core banking, fintech and identity ecosystem.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate has a proven track record of navigating, negotiating, and closing complex Reseller and OEM agreements with major financial technology ecosystems—specifically targeting banking infrastructure giants like Fiserv and Jack Henry.&nbsp;</p>
<p>You will be responsible for turning these platforms into successful commercial channels that scale Prove's reach and directly drive ARR. As an early team hire, this individual will help lay the commercial and operational foundation for our global reseller program.</p>
<h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>New Partner Sourcing:</strong> Own the end-to-end sourcing, structuring, and closing of complex partnership agreements with top-tier core banking platforms as well as strategic fraud, identity, and lending infrastructure providers.</li>
<li><strong>GTM Mobilization:</strong> Partner closely with Partner Success and Partner Marketing build comprehensive enablement playbooks, ensuring partner sales forces are fully equipped to position and distribute Prove's embedded solutions.</li>
<li><strong>Revenue Ownership:</strong> Drive the post-signature partner commercialization lifecycle to accelerate pipeline generation, manage partner-sourced ARR quotas, and maximize Prove's footprint within the partner's client base.</li>
<li><strong>Cross-Functional Alignment:</strong> Align closely with Prove's direct Sales + GTM leadership to map strategic accounts, manage channel conflict, and create a unified approach to market penetration.</li>
<li><strong>Program Architecture:</strong> Develop and refine Prove’s partner programs, pricing frameworks, and operational processes to establish scalable best practices for Reseller and OEM models.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications and Experience</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of professional work experience, with 3+ years specifically focused on sourcing, negotiating, and closing Reseller and OEM partnerships in the technology or financial services sector.</li>
<li>Proven track record of hitting and exceeding partner sales quotas.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience managing deep commercial relationships or closing deals with major core banking platforms (e.g., Fiserv, Jack Henry, FIS) is preferred.</li>
<li>Expertise in structuring complex technical and commercial agreements</li>
<li>Experience in high-growth, venture-backed, or pre-IPO technology companies is strongly preferred.</li>
<li>Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for partner meetings and industry events.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Skills and Attributes</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Discovery-first mindset: </strong>you ask before you pitch, and you can translate a prospect's business problem into a product &amp; GTM structure recommendation.</li>
<li><strong>Technical fluency: </strong>comfortable in conversations that involve API integration, compliance considerations and technical architecture, even when you're not the technical expert in the room.</li>
<li><strong>Data-driven:</strong> you own your pipeline numbers, understand what they mean, and use them to prioritize your time.</li>
<li><strong>Commercial grit:</strong> reseller and OEM partnerships with massive institutions are complex and lengthy; you stay persistent, creative, and strategically aligned without losing momentum.</li>
<li><strong>High Collaboration:</strong> you naturally bridge gaps across engineering, legal, product, and sales teams to bring highly multi-faceted deals across the finish line.</li>
</ul>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>The anticipated salary pay range for Metro 2 areas for this role is $165,000 - 180,000 plus sales incentive plan.<br>The anticipated salary pay range for Metro 3 areas for this role is&nbsp; $160,000 - $175,000 plus sales incentive plan.</p>
<p>Offered salary will be determined by the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, geo-location and abilities as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.</p>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Prove follows a market driven compensation philosophy based on geographic location and respective market rates. Job offers will be aligned to location. Please speak with your recruiter if you have questions. Prove defines:</p>
<ul>
<li>Metro 2 - NYC metro area, Seattle metro area, Los Angeles metro area, and the Miami metro area.</li>
<li>Metro 3 - all other cities across the domestic United States, with the exception of the San Francisco Bay Area.</li>
</ul>
<div><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks for FTE Provers:<br></strong></div>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salaries &amp; Bonus Plan (for eligible roles) and Equity Plan</li>
<li>Modern Health for financial, mental, and physical wellness</li>
<li>401(k) Retirement Plan &amp; Match (US Offices) and Local Country Pension (International Offices)</li>
<li>Unlimited Vacation and Flexible hours</li>
<li>Comprehensive medical benefits for you and your family ️</li>
<li>Emotional &amp; Physical Wellness – Access to wellness services (EAP &amp; Prove Well-Being Reimbursement)</li>
<li>Bottomless snacks &amp; beverages for certain office locations</li>
<li>Daily GrubHub stipend for lunch if coming into the office (US Offices)</li>
<li>A great place to work and connect with other talented Provers like yourself!</li>
</ul>
<div>
<p>Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Prove we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employment:</strong><br><br>Prove is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people regardless of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, age, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, veteran status or other personal characteristics&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Privacy &amp; Data Protection:</strong><br><br>When you are applying for a job at Prove, we collect and use your personal information in the job application process. To understand more about how Prove uses your personal information, please see our <a href="https://www.prove.com/legal/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy</a> on our website.<br><br></p>
</div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/prove-director-channel-partnerships">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/prove-director-channel-partnerships</a></p>
